body: An open-source framework for detecting and anonymizing personal information in text, images, and structured data.
plain_description: **Detect and de-identify sensitive information to help protect your organization’s data.** Presidio can identify and redact personal information in text and images. Customize detection rules for your business needs.
technical_description: An open-source framework for identifying and anonymizing personally identifiable information in text and images. It includes predefined and custom recognizers using named entity recognition, regular expressions, rules, checksums, and contextual analysis across multiple languages. Presidio supports Python and PySpark workloads, Docker, and Kubernetes, and includes image redaction for standard and DICOM medical images.
title: Presidio
